sections.title: Overview
descriptions: Officer Bronson T. Kitchen started working for the American Fork Police Department on August 5, 2024.

Officer Bronson T. Kitchen began working for the American Fork Police Department on August 5, 2024. Before joining AFPD, he held public-sector positions with Salt Lake County, the State of Utah, and the Utah Transit Authority.

sections.title: Employment
descriptions: Public compensation records show Bronson T. Kitchen working in several public-sector positions before joining the American Fork Police Department. In 2018, the Utah Transit Authority reported him under the titles Bus Operator Trainee and Extra Board Operator, a relief-driver position used to cover routes as needed. State of Utah records list him as a POST-certified correctional officer in 2020 and 2021. Salt Lake County subsequently listed him as a Deputy II in 2023 and 2024. By 2025, American Fork City employed him as a Police Officer I.
He also is the school resource officer for American Fork Jr. High School.
